title: Retry uploads after a dropped connection
description: Uploads that lose the connection now resume from the last confirmed chunk instead of starting over.

title: Remove the legacy v1 sync endpoint
description: The /v1/sync endpoint is gone. Clients must call /v2/sync, which has been available since 2.1.

title: Faster search index rebuild
description: Rebuilding the search index takes about a third of the time it used to on large projects.
